shared_elements: stylized bird-like or feathered forms (crest/plumage in A; wing-like carved head element in B)
justification: Both surfaces show schematic carving with dense parallel incised hatching used to render texture (crest/plumage-like fans in A, striated markings on B's upper element), and both hint at bird-like or plumed forms. However, A is a flat frieze of identical repeated vertical elements in a single ordered row beneath a horizontal band, while B is a three-dimensional composite figure with a crouching anthropomorphic body supporting a large bird-like head — no shared arrangement, scene or relationship between elements.
